about_the_game:
Get deeper into the world of Fritz Bauer's special unit with this comprehensive Prosecutor Edition! Created for those who want to experience every aspect of The Darkest Files.

This premium collection includes:

  • "The Chronicles of Crime - Art and Fact" Digital Artbook - explore concept art, character designs, and historical research that shaped the game

  • 6 High-Quality Digital Wallpapers for desktop and mobile devices

  • Complete Set of Exclusive Emotes for Twitch and other platforms

  • 5 Printable Posters featuring stunning artwork from the game

  • Digital Sticker Collection to show your support

  • 1 OST Teaser Track featuring "Five O'Clock Filing" - the atmospheric tune playing on the office radio

  • In-Depth Character Sheets revealing detailed backstories, motivations, and secrets of all key characters

The Prosecutor Edition is the definitive way to experience everything The Darkest Files has to offer, combining the immersive gameplay with exclusive behind-the-scenes content that reveals the creative process and historical research behind this unique investigation game.

Perfect for collectors, history enthusiasts, and dedicated fans who want to support our work in bringing this important chapter of history to life.

To access this content please proceed as follows:

Right-click on the product in your Steam Library and select "Properties".

Under the "Local Files" tab, select "Browse...".

Within the product's local files, locate a folder that has a similar name to the content you are searching for.

content_descriptors.notes: This Game may contain content not appropriate for all ages. Some scenes feature disturbing content in the form of narrative text or imagery and a sensitive general theme.
